item.description: This week in Oakland: an exhibit honoring Oscar Grant, and the Lunar New Year and Black History Month festival in Chinatown Other events include unconventional exhibits at the Sneaker Museum and the downtown ice rink. Also, a punk show at Stay Gold Deli.

item.title: Great-granddaughter of Piedmont’s first Black residents, who were forced out by a ‘terror campaign,’ sues city
item.description: Great-granddaughter of Piedmont’s first Black residents, who were forced out by a ‘terror campaign,’ sues city In 1924, Sidney Dearing's family faced attempted bombings, a mob attack, and KKK threats. Civil rights attorneys say their descendants are owed an apology and compensation.

item.description: Searching for a Valentine? East Bay spots where sparks fly for singles Yes, real love is out there. Try finding it at one of these nine East Bay restaurants and bars.

item.title: Oakland’s public schools have a facilities challenge
item.description: Oakland’s public schools have a facilities challenge The district‘s empty buildings are languishing when they could be generating revenue. And it opened a new $62 million headquarters this year just before facing deep cuts to central staff. A new facilities plan is expected later this month.
